results.headline: Did new taxes just cut ITC's profit by 27%?

issues.claim: 27.12% drop in its consolidated net profit for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027
issues.detail: The 27.12% drop in net profit refers to ITC's standalone net profit, not its consolidated net profit. Consolidated net profit declined by approximately 15.6% to 16.2% year-on-year.
issues.correction: ITC Limited reported a 27.12% drop in its standalone net profit for the first quarter of fiscal year 2027. Its consolidated net profit declined by 15.61% to ₹4,508.79 crore.
issues.source: Tobacco Insider, ITC profit slips as cigarette tax hike, agri slowdown weigh on Q1, ITC Q1 results: Consolidated profit drops 16% YoY to ₹4,394 crore; cigarettes revenue surges 81% YoY, ITC Ltd's Q1 FY27 Consolidated Net Profit Declines 15.61% To ₹4,508.79 Crore, ITC Q1 profit declines 15.6 pc to Rs 4508.79 cr; non-cigarette FMCG posts robust growth

issues.claim: falling to ₹3,579 crore
issues.detail: The figure ₹3,579 crore represents ITC's standalone net profit for Q1 FY27, not its consolidated net profit. Consolidated net profit was reported as ₹4,508.79 crore (or ₹4,394.13 crore in some reports, depending on specific accounting for attributable profit).
issues.correction: ITC's standalone net profit fell to ₹3,579 crore. Its consolidated net profit fell to ₹4,508.79 crore (or ₹4,394.13 crore).
issues.source: Tobacco Insider, ITC Q1 results: Consolidated profit drops 16% YoY to ₹4,394 crore; cigarettes revenue surges 81% YoY, ITC Ltd's Q1 FY27 Consolidated Net Profit Declines 15.61% To ₹4,508.79 Crore, ITC Q1 Results: Net Profit Falls 27% to ₹3579 Crore Despite Revenue Jump, ITC Q1 profit plunges 27% due to record cigarette taxes and West Asia crisis

issues.claim: from ₹4,911 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous year (Q1 FY26)
issues.detail: The figure ₹4,911 crore refers to ITC's standalone net profit for Q1 FY26, not its consolidated net profit for the same period. Consolidated net profit for Q1 FY26 was reported around ₹5,343.41 crore or ₹5,244.20 crore.
issues.correction: ITC's standalone net profit for Q1 FY27 fell from approximately ₹4,909 crore in the corresponding quarter of the previous year (Q1 FY26). Its consolidated net profit for Q1 FY27 fell from ₹5,343.41 crore (or ₹5,244.20 crore) in Q1 FY26.
issues.source: Tobacco Insider, Cigarette tax hike impacts ITC's Q1 net profit, down 16.2%, ITC Q1 results: Consolidated profit drops 16% YoY to ₹4,394 crore; cigarettes revenue surges 81% YoY, ITC Ltd's Q1 FY27 Consolidated Net Profit Declines 15.61% To ₹4,508.79 Crore, ITC Q1 profit declines 15.6 pc to Rs 4508.79 cr; non-cigarette FMCG posts robust growth

issues.claim: primarily attributed to higher cigarette taxes impacting sales volumes and a one-time charge from a prior period.
issues.detail: While higher cigarette taxes were a primary factor for the profit decline, consolidated reported net profit for Q1 FY27 included a 'one-time gain' (from the revaluation of an equity stake in Sproutlife Foods), not a 'one-time charge'. This gain actually supported the consolidated PAT.
issues.correction: This significant decline was primarily attributed to higher cigarette taxes impacting sales volumes, with consolidated net profit being supported by a one-time gain from an acquisition.
issues.source: Tobacco Insider, ITC profit slips as cigarette tax hike, agri slowdown weigh on Q1, ITC Q1 Profit Drops 15.6% to Rs 4508 Cr on Higher Expenses, ITC Shares Climb Over 4% After Q1 Results Despite Profit Decline. What's Driving The Rally?

issues.claim: total revenue from operations managed a slight increase of 2.1% year-on-year
issues.detail: ITC's consolidated gross revenue from operations increased significantly (between 24% and 28% YoY) to around ₹29,400 - ₹29,500 crore. However, its consolidated net revenue from operations actually declined by 11.0% to 11.1% YoY. The stated 2.1% increase is incorrect and does not match any reported revenue metric.
issues.correction: ITC's consolidated gross revenue from operations managed a substantial increase of 27.6% year-on-year, while consolidated net revenue from operations declined by 11.1%.

issues.claim: reaching ₹17,043 crore.
issues.detail: This revenue figure is incorrect. Consolidated gross revenue from operations was reported around ₹29,523.30 crore, while consolidated net revenue was around ₹19,114 crore (or ₹18,955 crore). Standalone net revenue was ₹16,812 crore.
issues.correction: Consolidated gross revenue from operations reached approximately ₹29,523 crore. Consolidated net revenue from operations reached approximately ₹19,114 crore.

results.notes: The story accurately identifies the central event (ITC's Q1 FY27 results announcement) and correctly states that higher cigarette taxes were a key factor. However, it significantly misrepresents several core financial figures, particularly by confusing standalone and consolidated results, stating an incorrect profit percentage and absolute value, and misreporting revenue growth and its corresponding value. Additionally, it incorrectly identifies a 'one-time charge' when a 'one-time gain' was reported. (escalated from source mode — original links were unfetchable)
